label_definition: Primary endpoint: developmental age band, age >= 10.0 y = 1. Negative control: CBCL attention above cohort median = 1.
montage_note: 18 of 129 HydroCel GSN electrodes at international 10-20 positions, selected by electrode number: E22~Fp1, E9~Fp2, E33~F7, E24~F3, E11~Fz, E124~F4, E122~F8, E45~T7, E36~C3, E104~C4, E108~T8, E58~P7, E52~P3, E62~Pz, E92~P4, E96~P8, E70~O1, E83~O2. The vertex electrode Cz is the recording reference in this montage and is identically zero, so it is excluded rather than carried as a permanently invalid graph node. The code selects by electrode number only and infers no anatomy.
